home.headline: Transforming Ideas into
home.description: I build AI assistants and the cloud systems that keep them running.

bio: A Python developer and DevOps engineer with 9+ years of experience building scalable, data-driven applications. I specialize in FastAPI, LangChain, and AI-powered solutions — from intelligent chatbots to automated data pipelines.

My work spans the full stack: crafting production-grade backends, architecting cloud infrastructure across Azure, AWS, and GCP using Terraform and Pulumi, and building voice assistants and AI workflows that solve real business problems.

When I'm not shipping code, I'm exploring new ways to bridge AI with real-world challenges — whether it's building low-latency voice agents, automating workflows, or turning raw data into actionable insights.

projects.name: Fonki
projects.tagline: An AI phone assistant that answers every call, 24/7.
projects.description: AI-powered phone assistant available 24/7. Fully automated call center that answers every call, qualifies leads, and books appointments around the clock — even outside business hours. 100% GDPR compliant, made in Germany.
overview: Fonki is an AI-powered phone assistant that works as a fully automated call center. It answers every incoming call, qualifies leads and books appointments around the clock, including outside business hours.
It's built for businesses in Germany: made in Germany and 100% GDPR compliant.

features.title: Always on
features.text: Answers every call around the clock, even outside business hours.

features.title: Lead qualification
features.text: Qualifies callers automatically before they reach your team.

features.title: Appointment booking
features.text: Books appointments directly during the call.

features.title: GDPR compliant
features.text: 100% GDPR compliant and made in Germany.

projects.name: PAFIS
projects.tagline: AI decision support for aircraft fault isolation.
projects.description: Predictive Avionics Fault Isolation System — an AI-driven decision-support platform that helps aviation maintenance teams resolve aircraft faults faster by correlating ECAM messages with MEL logic, circuit breaker data, and root cause analysis.
overview: PAFIS (Predictive Avionics Fault Isolation System) is an AI-driven decision-support platform for aviation maintenance. It helps airlines, MROs and engineers isolate aircraft faults faster and more accurately.

It correlates ECAM messages with MEL logic, circuit breaker data, reset procedures and probable-cause flows, and adds a chat interface for asking about faults. It's a reference tool: OEM- and FAA-approved documentation always comes first.

features.title: Smart fault mapping
features.text: Connects ECAM messages to MEL logic, circuit breaker locations, reset procedures and probable-cause flows.

features.title: Root cause analysis
features.text: Guides engineers from a fault message to its most likely cause.

features.title: Chat with PAFIS
features.text: Ask about a fault in plain language.

features.title: Predictive intelligence
features.text: Coming soon: fault history by tail number, trend analysis and predictive diagnostics.

projects.name: Fastify Admin
projects.description: A self-hosted admin panel for Fastify + MikroORM. One plugin, zero frontend work — get authentication, RBAC, and full CRUD for every entity in minutes.
overview: Fastify Admin is a self-hosted admin panel for Fastify + MikroORM. Register one plugin and get authentication, role-based access control and full CRUD for every entity. The UI is bundled, so there is no frontend to build.
Entity views are plain classes that choose which fields to list, show, edit and add, and a CLI scaffolds projects, runs migrations and manages users.

features.title: Auto CRUD
features.text: List, show, create, edit and delete views for every MikroORM entity.

features.title: Authentication
features.text: Email/password with verification, optional email OTP MFA, and sign-in with Google, GitHub and Microsoft.

features.title: RBAC
features.text: Per-entity roles and permissions, seeded automatically and manageable in the UI.

features.title: Zero frontend
features.text: The UI ships bundled, with light, dark and system themes.

features.title: CLI
features.text: npx fastify-admin scaffolds projects, generates resources, runs migrations and manages users.

snippet.title: Quick start
snippet.code:
npm install fastify-admin
npx fastify-admin init          # scaffold a project
npx fastify-admin migrate:up    # apply migrations
npx fastify-admin create-admin  # first admin user

projects.name: AdminJS Keycloak Provider
projects.description: Open-source Keycloak authentication provider for AdminJS with Express integration. Integrates OAuth2 / OpenID Connect for secure enterprise authentication.
overview: @gugupy/adminjs-keycloak is a minimal AdminJS auth provider for Keycloak. It exchanges an OAuth2 authorization code for tokens, fetches the user's info and returns an AdminJS CurrentAdmin object.
It's tested with @adminjs/express, and a runnable example app shows the full login and logout flow.

features.title: Code exchange
features.text: Exchanges the authorization code for tokens and fetches user info from Keycloak.

features.title: CurrentAdmin mapping
features.text: Returns the signed-in user as an AdminJS CurrentAdmin object.

features.title: Express callback
features.text: A small middleware turns Keycloak's GET callback into the POST AdminJS expects.

features.title: Single sign-out
features.text: Logout clears the session and redirects to Keycloak's logout endpoint.

projects.name: Hausaufgaben Wiki
projects.tagline: Homework for every class in Germany, no sign-up needed.
projects.description: Homework management platform for German schools with AI-assisted validation, school/grade/class filters, calendar interface, and comment/solution attachments.
overview: Hausaufgaben Wiki is a free homework platform for pupils in Germany. Pick your school, year group and class to see the homework posted for each day, on desktop or mobile.
Anyone in the class can add homework with subject, date and description, and it's visible to the whole class right away. No account, password or email is needed.

features.title: No sign-up
features.text: No account, no password, no email.

features.title: Nationwide
features.text: Search for your school and pick your year group and class; missing schools can be reported.

features.title: Shared homework
features.text: Entries with subject, date and description are visible to the whole class immediately.

features.title: Daily overview
features.text: See each day's homework at a glance, also on mobile.

features.title: AI-assisted validation
features.text: Entries are checked with AI assistance.

features.title: Comments & solutions
features.text: Attach comments and solutions to homework entries.

projects.name: Langchain Agent Bot
projects.tagline: A Chatwoot agent bot that answers from your SQL database.
projects.description: Intelligent chatbot implementation using LangChain integrated with Chatwoot for seamless customer support automation. Contributed to official Chatwoot implementation examples.
overview: A sample Chatwoot agent bot built with LangChain's SQLDatabaseChain. Customers ask questions in a Chatwoot conversation and the bot answers them with data from a SQL database.
It's part of Chatwoot's official implementation-examples repository.

features.title: Natural-language SQL
features.text: LangChain and OpenAI turn questions into queries against your database.

features.title: Chatwoot agent bot
features.text: Plugs in through the agent bot's outgoing webhook URL.

features.title: Scoped access
features.text: Choose which tables the bot is allowed to read.

features.title: Any SQL database
features.text: PostgreSQL by default, others through SQLAlchemy dialects.

snippet.title: Run
snippet.code:
python3 -m gunicorn app:app
# Chatwoot bot outgoing URL: http://localhost:8000/langchain

projects.name: Morse Code Translator
projects.tagline: Plain text to Morse code and back, from Python or the terminal.
projects.description: Python module for converting plaintext to Morse code and vice versa. Published on PyPI as morse-transcript for easy integration in any Python project.
overview: morse-transcript is a Python module for converting plain text to Morse code and back. It's published on PyPI and ships with a morse command-line tool.
Spacing follows the Morse convention: three spaces between letters and seven between words.

features.title: Encode & decode
features.text: MorseCodeTranslator().encrypt() and .decrypt() in two lines of Python.

features.title: CLI
features.text: morse encrypt and morse decrypt straight from the terminal.

features.title: On PyPI
features.text: pip install morse-transcript and you're ready.

features.title: Tested
features.text: Test coverage tracked with Codecov.

snippet.title: Try it
snippet.code:
pip install -U morse-transcript
morse encrypt --text 'MORSE CODE'
# --   ---   .-.   ...   .       -.-.   ---   -..   .

projects.name: Git Aliases
projects.tagline: An interactive CLI for managing your global Git aliases.
projects.description: Interactive Go CLI for managing useful aliases in Git's global configuration. Run it as “git aliases” — ships as a single ~4 MB binary for macOS, Linux, and Windows.
overview: Git Aliases is a Go command-line tool for managing aliases in Git's global configuration without hand-editing ~/.gitconfig. Git runs any git-<name> program on your PATH as a subcommand, so once installed it runs as git aliases.
It builds to a single ~4 MB binary for macOS, Linux and Windows, and the binary needs nothing but Git.

features.title: Built-in alias set
features.text: Pick from ready-made aliases like st, lg, last, unstage and theirs, and install them in one go.

features.title: Custom aliases
features.text: Alias name, a searchable list of common Git commands and the command itself on one screen, with a preview before anything is replaced.

features.title: Filter and remove
features.text: Filter your global aliases and remove the ones you no longer need.

features.title: Keyboard-first
features.text: Space to toggle, Ctrl+A to select all, Tab between fields and Esc back to the menu.

features.title: Single binary
features.text: Cross-compiled for macOS, Linux and Windows, with no runtime besides Git.

snippet.title: Install & run
snippet.code:
go install .
git aliases            # start the interactive CLI

# a few of the built-in aliases
git st       # git status --short --branch
git lg       # git log --oneline --graph --decorate --all
git last     # git log -1 HEAD
git unstage  # git reset HEAD --
